import re
from datetime import datetime


def extract(text: str) -> dict:
    amount_match = re.search(
        r"Spotify\s+Premium\s+Individual\s+[—-]\s+Rs\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*/\s*month",
        text,
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    if not amount_match:
        raise ValueError("Missing Spotify plan amount label")

    due_match = re.search(
        r"Your\s+next\s+payment\s+of\s+Rs\s*[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?\s+is\s+on\s+(\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{4})\."
        ,
        text,
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    if not due_match:
        raise ValueError("Missing next payment due date label")

    amount = float(amount_match.group(1).replace(",", ""))
    due_date = datetime.strptime(due_match.group(1), "%d/%m/%Y").strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

    return {
        "type": "subscription_receipt",
        "provider": "Spotify",
        "amount": amount,
        "currency": "INR",
        "due_date": due_date,
        "service": "Spotify",
    }
data.notes: Parses Spotify India Premium receipt amount from plan line and next payment date from the labeled sentence.
